in_marathi.name: Khushi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khushi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The Sanskrit word ‘Khushi’ means ‘joy’, ‘happiness’, or ‘contentment’. It is derived from the root word ‘Khus’ which means ‘content’ or ‘satisfied’. In Hindu mythology, Khushi is personified as a goddess of happiness, joy, and pleasure.
